weightlifting-federation-certification: Official approval or compliance of the product by strength-sport federations, such as IPF or IWF.
wetsuit-boot-height: Classifies the height/cut of the boot on the leg, influencing coverage, mobility and water entry.
wetsuit-entry-system: Describes the type and location of the opening/zip system used to get into the wetsuit.
wetsuit-seam-construction: Specifies how the seams are built and sealed, affecting warmth, flexibility, and durability.
wheel-brake-type: Details the braking configuration provided on the cart’s wheels or casters.
wheel-core-type: Describes the construction style of the wheel core, which influences weight, rigidity, and energy transfer.
wheel-hardness: Specifies the hardness level of skateboard wheels, e.g. 75A
wheel-hub-placement: Specifies the position of the wheel hub in skateboards, like centerset or offset
wheel-illumination: Indicates whether the wheel has built-in lighting or glow features.
wheel-material: Identifies the primary composition of the wheels, which affects durability, grip and vibration dampening.
wheel-part-type: Identifies the specific component of a vehicle's wheel system, like wheel bearing or wheel hub
wheel-profile: Describes the cross-sectional shape of the wheel that affects speed, grip, and agility.
wheel-setup-type: Defines the wheel configuration style used on the skates.
wheel-type: Specifies the kind of wheel for cycling products, such as inflatable or solid
whip-style: Classifies the product by its specific equestrian whip or crop style or intended discipline.
whistle-purpose: Identifies the primary intended application of the whistle (sport coaching, marine safety, dog training, etc.).
whitewater-kayak-style: Primary design intent within the whitewater segment (e.g., Creekboat, River Runner, Playboat).
whitewater-rating-class: Highest International Scale of River Difficulty class the raft is rated to handle.
wildlife-attractant-scent: Identifies the primary scent used to lure wildlife, covering natural food scents and pheromone-type scents.
willow-grade: Specifies the quality grade of the willow used, indicating grain structure and overall performance level.
willow-type: Identifies the kind of willow or alternative material used for the bat blade, which greatly affects performance, durability, and price.
windbreak-purpose: Defines the primary intended use case of the windbreak.
windfoil-board-mounting-system: Specifies the foil box or mounting interface built into the windfoil board.
windfoil-sail-style: Classifies the sail by intended riding style or discipline.
window-configuration: Indicates the presence and relative size of transparent visibility windows on the wingfoil wing.
windsurf-fin-style: Classifies the fin by the intended sailing discipline or usage style (e.g., wave, slalom, weed).
windsurfing-board-style: Specifies the type of windsurfing board, such as freestyle or slalom
windsurfing-connection-standard: Mechanical interface or box type used to attach the part to the board or rig.
windsurfing-sail-style: Classifies the sail’s intended discipline or use case, such as wave, freeride, or foil.
wing-handle-type: Specifies the style of hand grip system on the wingfoil wing.
wing-part-type: Identifies the specific component or replacement part for a wingfoil wing.
wingfoiling-style: Indicates the specific wingfoiling discipline or riding style the product targets.
wiring-configuration: Indicates whether the fencing epee is supplied pre-wired for electric scoring, unwired, wireless, or intended for non-electric practice.
wobbler-style: Defines the specific design/action style of the wobbler, such as crankbait or jerkbait.
wood-finish: Describes the finishing treatment or construction method applied to wood products (e.g., solid wood, veneered, engineered, oiled, lacquered, painted)
work-capacity: Describes the performance level of a product, such as heavy-duty or light-duty
wrap-style: Denotes how many times the belt is intended to wrap around the waist.
wrestling-dummy-design: Overall body shape or posture of the dummy, such as standing human shape or throwing bag, which dictates applicable training drills.
wrestling-mat-safety-certifications: Lists any industry or sports body safety certifications or standards the mat meets.
wrist-strap-style: Describes the style of wrist strap (or lack thereof) that affects support and fit.
wrist-support-style: Identifies the construction or style of the wrist support, such as brace, glove, tape, or wrap, to aid user preference and performance selection.
yarn-finish-or-effect: Highlights special visual or functional treatments applied to the yarn such as fluorescence or metallic sparkle.
yoke-type: Identifies the style of cradle or yoke that supports the firearm on the monopod.
zipper-side: Specifies the side on which the main zipper is located when the sleeping bag is lying face-up.
